P4 DE Model No FE
```{r}
# ============================================================
# 0. LOAD LIBRARIES
# ============================================================
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(caret)
library(pROC)
library(randomForest)

# ============================================================
# 1. FILTER DATASET (P4 ONLY, ALL YEARS)
# ============================================================
dt_data <- de_all %>%
  filter(Conference_Level == "P4")

# ============================================================
# 1.5 CONVERT PERCENTAGE COLUMNS TO NUMERIC (CRITICAL)
# ============================================================
percent_cols <- c(
  "Pass.Rush.Win.Percentage",
  "Pass.Rush.Pressure.Percentage",
  "Negative.Rush.Grade.Percentage",
  "Positive.Rush.Grade.Percentage",
  "Successful.Plays.Percentage",
  "Missed.Tackle.Percentage",
  "Missed.Tackle.Percentage.on.Run.Plays",
  "Pass.Missed.Tackles.Percentage",
  "Forced.Incompletion.Percentage"
)

dt_data <- dt_data %>%
  mutate(across(
    any_of(percent_cols),
    ~ as.numeric(gsub("%", "", .)) / 100
  ))

# ============================================================
# 2. DROP COVERAGE + UNWANTED FEATURES
# ============================================================
dt_data <- dt_data %>%
  select(-any_of(c(
    # Identifiers
    "Player.Id", "Jersey.Number", "Player.College.GSIS",

    # Coverage
    "Coverage.Snaps", "Coverage.Grade", "Coverage.Grades",
    "Targetted.in.Coverage", "Receptions.Allowed",
    "Passing.Yards.Allowed", "Passing.Touchdowns.Allowed",
    "Yards.Per.Reception.Allowed", "First.Downs.Allowed",
    "Interceptions", "Forced.Incompletions",
    "NFL.Passer.Rating.Allowed",
    "Receiving.Yards.Allowed.per.Snap",
    "Plays.of.15..Yards.Allowed",
    "Open.Targets", "Dropped.Int",

    # Volume/context (per your request)
    "Pass.Rush.Plays",
    "Games.Won",
    "Key.Plays",
    "Defensive.Plays",
    "Negative.Plays",
    "Rush.Plays",
    "Run.Plays",
    "Coverage.Plays"
  )))

# ============================================================
# 3. PLAYER INFO (IDENTIFIERS ONLY)
# ============================================================
player_info <- dt_data %>%
  mutate(Row_ID = row_number()) %>%
  select(Row_ID, Name, Team, Season, Conference, All_Con)


# ============================================================
# 4. MODEL MATRIX (NUMERIC ONLY, KEEP ALL PLAYERS)
# ============================================================
df_model <- dt_data %>%
  mutate(Row_ID = row_number()) %>%
  select(
    Row_ID,
    All_Con,
    where(is.numeric),
    -Season
  ) %>%
  select(where(~ !all(is.na(.))))

# Median imputation (CRITICAL FIX)
df_model <- df_model %>%
  mutate(across(
    .cols = -c(Row_ID, All_Con),
    .fns  = ~ ifelse(is.na(.), median(., na.rm = TRUE), .)
  ))


# ============================================================
# 5. REMOVE NEAR-ZERO VARIANCE
# ============================================================
predictors <- df_model %>% select(-Row_ID, -All_Con)

nzv <- nearZeroVar(predictors, saveMetrics = TRUE)
predictors <- predictors[, !nzv$nzv, drop = FALSE]

# ============================================================
# 6. REMOVE HIGHLY CORRELATED FEATURES
# ============================================================
cor_mat <- cor(predictors)
high_cor <- findCorrelation(cor_mat, cutoff = 0.70)

predictors <- predictors[, -high_cor, drop = FALSE]

# ============================================================
# 7. FINAL MODEL DATAFRAME
# ============================================================
df_final <- predictors %>%
  mutate(
    All_Con = df_model$All_Con,
    Row_ID  = df_model$Row_ID
  )

# ============================================================
# 8. TRAIN / TEST SPLIT (ALL YEARS)
# ============================================================
set.seed(42)
train_idx <- createDataPartition(df_final$All_Con, p = 0.8, list = FALSE)

train_data <- df_final[train_idx, ]
test_data  <- df_final[-train_idx, ]

x_cols <- setdiff(names(train_data), c("All_Con", "Row_ID"))

# ============================================================
# 9. TRAIN RANDOM FOREST
# ============================================================
rf_model <- randomForest(
  x = train_data[, x_cols],
  y = as.factor(train_data$All_Con),
  ntree = 500,
  mtry = floor(sqrt(length(x_cols))),
  importance = TRUE
)

# ============================================================
# 10. TEST SET PREDICTIONS
# ============================================================
test_probs <- predict(rf_model, test_data[, x_cols], type = "prob")
test_preds <- predict(rf_model, test_data[, x_cols])

test_data$Composite_Score <- test_probs[, 2]

# ============================================================
# 11. PLAYER GRADES
# ============================================================
test_data <- test_data %>%
  mutate(
    Player_Grade = case_when(
      Composite_Score >= quantile(Composite_Score, 0.90) ~ "A",
      Composite_Score >= quantile(Composite_Score, 0.75) ~ "B",
      Composite_Score >= quantile(Composite_Score, 0.50) ~ "C",
      Composite_Score >= quantile(Composite_Score, 0.25) ~ "D",
      TRUE ~ "F"
    )
  )

# ============================================================
# 12. MERGE PLAYER INFO
# ============================================================
test_with_names <- test_data %>%
  left_join(player_info, by = "Row_ID")

# ============================================================
# 13. FEATURE IMPORTANCE TABLE
# ============================================================
importance_df <- data.frame(
  Feature = rownames(importance(rf_model)),
  Importance = importance(rf_model)[, "MeanDecreaseGini"]
) %>% arrange(desc(Importance))

print(importance_df)
view(importance_df)

# ============================================================
# 14. VISUALIZATIONS
# ============================================================
ggplot(test_data, aes(Player_Grade)) +
  geom_bar(fill = "darkgreen") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Player Grade Distribution")

ggplot(test_data, aes(Composite_Score)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.05, fill = "darkorange", color = "white") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Composite Score Distribution")

roc_obj <- roc(test_data$All_Con, test_data$Composite_Score)
#plot(roc_obj, col = "blue", main = "ROC Curve")
#auc(roc_obj)

# ============================================================
# 15. METRICS (YOUR EXACT FORMAT)
# ============================================================
conf_matrix <- confusionMatrix(test_preds, as.factor(test_data$All_Con))

calc_metrics <- function(cm) {
  TP <- cm$table[2, 2]
  TN <- cm$table[1, 1]
  FP <- cm$table[1, 2]
  FN <- cm$table[2, 1]

  accuracy <- cm$overall["Accuracy"]
  precision <- if ((TP + FP) == 0) NA else TP / (TP + FP)
  recall <- if ((TP + FN) == 0) NA else TP / (TP + FN)
  specificity <- if ((TN + FP) == 0) NA else TN / (TN + FP)
  balanced_accuracy <- mean(c(recall, specificity))
  f1_score <- if ((precision + recall) == 0) NA else 2 * precision * recall / (precision + recall)

  tibble(
    Accuracy = as.numeric(accuracy),
    Precision = precision,
    Recall = recall,
    Specificity = specificity,
    Balanced_Accuracy = balanced_accuracy,
    F1_Score = f1_score
  )
}

calc_metrics(conf_matrix)

# ============================================================
# 16. FULL DATASET PREDICTIONS (2021–2025)
# ============================================================
full_probs <- predict(rf_model, df_final[, x_cols], type = "prob")

df_final$Composite_Score <- full_probs[, 2]

full_data <- df_final %>%
  left_join(player_info, by = "Row_ID") %>%
  mutate(
    Player_Grade = case_when(
      Composite_Score >= quantile(Composite_Score, 0.90) ~ "A",
      Composite_Score >= quantile(Composite_Score, 0.75) ~ "B",
      Composite_Score >= quantile(Composite_Score, 0.50) ~ "C",
      Composite_Score >= quantile(Composite_Score, 0.25) ~ "D",
      TRUE ~ "F"
    )
  )

# ============================================================
# 17. YEAR FILTER (CHANGE THIS LINE ONLY)
# ============================================================
YEAR_TO_VIEW <- 2025

players_by_year <- full_data %>%
  filter(Season == YEAR_TO_VIEW) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score)) %>%
  select(Name, Team, Season, Composite_Score, Player_Grade)

print(players_by_year)
view(players_by_year)

# ============================================================
# FEATURE IMPORTANCE BAR PLOT
# ============================================================
ggplot(importance_df, aes(
  x = reorder(Feature, Importance),
  y = Importance
)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Random Forest Feature Importance",
    subtitle = "Mean Decrease in Gini",
    x = "Feature",
    y = "Importance"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)


```

P4 Week 1
```{r}
# --- P4 Week 1 Defensive End Grading ---

# ---------------- 1) Prep week1 like training --------------------------
de_week1_proc <- de_week1_2024 %>%
  filter(Conference_Level == "P4", Team != "ALABAMA") %>%
  mutate(
    Defensive.Snaps = ifelse(is.na(Defensive.Snaps), 1, Defensive.Snaps),
    Row_ID = row_number()
  )

# --- Use the features from your importance plot with additions (no "plays" stats, no coverage) ---
model_features_de <- c(
  # Primary pass rush stats
  "Sacks",
  "Pass.Rush.Productivity",
  "Beaten.Defender",
  "Hits",
  "Pursuit.Pressure",
  "Unblocked.Pass.Rush",
  "Batted.Passes.at.the.Line",
  # Run defense stats (no "plays")
  "Run.Tackle.for.Losss.or.No.Gain",
  "Assist.Tackles.on.Run.Plays",
  "Missed.Tackles.on.Run.Plays",
  "Tackles.on.Pass.Plays",
  "Missed.Tackles.on.Pass.Plays",
  "Assist.on.Pass.Plays",
  "Pass.Tackle.for.Loss.or.No.Gain",
  # Other stats
  "Average.Depth.of.Tackle",
  "Lined.up.in.Press.Coverage",
  "Passer.Rating.Allowed",
  "Forced.Fumble",
  "Fumble.Recovery",
  "Drops...Off.Targets.Receptions.Forced",
  "Pass.Break.Up",
  # ADDITIONAL STATS
  "Run.Stop",
  "Missed.Tackle.Percentage.on.Run.Plays",
  "Pass.Missed.Tackles.Percentage",
  "First.Contact",
  "Total.Tackles",
  "Stops",
  "Assistant",
  "Missed.Tackle.Percentage",
  "Tackle.for.Loss.or.No.Gain",
  "Hurries",
  "Total.Pressures.Generated",
  # NEW FEATURES
  "Pass.Rush.Grade",
  "Run.Defense.Grade",
  "Defensive.Grades"
)

# --- DE Weights with adjustments ---
# Times 2: Sacks, Pass.Rush.Productivity, Beaten.Defender
# Times 1.5: Run.Defense.Grade, Hits, Average.Depth.of.Tackle
# Added weights for new stats
feature_weights_de <- c(
  # Times 2
  "Sacks" = 108.796188,                       # 54.398094 * 2
  "Pass.Rush.Productivity" = 90.087542,       # 45.043771 * 2
  "Beaten.Defender" = 86.913982,              # 43.456991 * 2
  # Times 1.5
  "Run.Defense.Grade" = 62.097845,            # 41.398563 * 1.5
  "Hits" = 47.653122,                         # 31.768748 * 1.5
  "Average.Depth.of.Tackle" = 46.547483,      # 31.031655 * 1.5
  # Original weights
  "Run.Tackle.for.Losss.or.No.Gain" = 24.913214,
  "Assist.Tackles.on.Run.Plays" = 24.435646,
  "Pursuit.Pressure" = 22.291809,
  "Unblocked.Pass.Rush" = 19.064269,
  "Tackles.on.Pass.Plays" = 18.470684,
  "Missed.Tackles.on.Pass.Plays" = -16.647273, # Negative - lower is better
  "Missed.Tackles.on.Run.Plays" = -16.559884,  # Negative - lower is better
  "Lined.up.in.Press.Coverage" = 10.713279,
  "Passer.Rating.Allowed" = 10.710927,
  "Assist.on.Pass.Plays" = 10.332566,
  "Batted.Passes.at.the.Line" = 9.456357,
  "Forced.Fumble" = 9.010061,
  "Fumble.Recovery" = 6.294825,
  "Pass.Tackle.for.Loss.or.No.Gain" = 6.266325,
  "Drops...Off.Targets.Receptions.Forced" = 4.490742,
  "Pass.Break.Up" = 3.167793,
  # ADDITIONAL STAT WEIGHTS
  "Run.Stop" = 20,
  "Missed.Tackle.Percentage.on.Run.Plays" = -12,  # Negative - lower is better
  "Pass.Missed.Tackles.Percentage" = -10,          # Negative - lower is better
  "First.Contact" = 10,
  "Total.Tackles" = 20,
  "Stops" = 25,
  "Assistant" = 15,
  "Missed.Tackle.Percentage" = -15,                # Negative - lower is better
  "Tackle.for.Loss.or.No.Gain" = 12,
  "Hurries" = 18,
  "Total.Pressures.Generated" = 22,
  # NEW FEATURE WEIGHTS
  "Pass.Rush.Grade" = 50,
  "Defensive.Grades" = 45
)

# --- Ensure all features exist in DE data ---
for (f in model_features_de) {
  if (!f %in% names(de_week1_proc)) {
    de_week1_proc[[f]] <- NA_real_
  }
}

# --- Apply the same processing as other positions ---
percent_to_numeric <- function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) {
    out <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("%","", x)))
    return(ifelse(is.na(out), NA_real_, out/100))
  }
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}

# Build numeric matrix
de_input_all <- de_week1_proc %>%
  mutate(
    across(all_of(model_features_de), ~ {
      v <- percent_to_numeric(.x)
      v[is.infinite(v)] <- NA_real_
      v
    })
  )

# Impute missing values
feats_needing_impute <- model_features_de
de_medians <- vapply(
  feats_needing_impute,
  function(f) suppressWarnings(stats::median(as.numeric(de_input_all[[f]]), na.rm = TRUE)),
  numeric(1)
)
de_medians[is.na(de_medians)] <- 0

for (f in model_features_de) {
  fill_val <- ifelse(f %in% names(de_medians), de_medians[[f]], 0)
  de_input_all[[f]][is.na(de_input_all[[f]])] <- fill_val
}

# Calculate weighted composite score
calculate_weighted_score <- function(data, features, weights) {
  scores <- rep(0, nrow(data))
  total_weight <- sum(abs(weights))
  
  for (i in seq_along(features)) {
    feature <- features[i]
    weight <- weights[i]
    
    # Normalize each feature to 0-1 scale
    if (sd(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
      normalized_feature <- (data[[feature]] - min(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE)) / 
        (max(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE) - min(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE))
    } else {
      normalized_feature <- 0.5
    }
    
    # For negative weights, invert the score (lower raw value = higher score)
    if (weight < 0) {
      normalized_feature <- 1 - normalized_feature
    }
    
    scores <- scores + (normalized_feature * abs(weight))
  }
  
  return(scores / total_weight)
}

de_input_all$Composite_Score <- calculate_weighted_score(de_input_all, model_features_de, feature_weights_de)

# --- Rescale Scores (0–100 + 2 decimals) like QB scores ---
if (length(unique(de_input_all$Composite_Score)) > 1) {
  min_s <- min(de_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)

      )
    )

}

  )

      Composite_Score >= 80.0 ~ "A",
      Composite_Score >= 60.0 ~ "B",
      Composite_Score >= 40.0 ~ "C",
      Composite_Score >= 20.0 ~ "D",

    )
  )

# --- Join scores + grades back ---

  )

    Defensive.Snaps,

  ) %>%

View(p4_de_full_stats)
```

```{r}
# Calculate weighted composite score
calculate_weighted_score <- function(data, features, weights) {
  scores <- rep(0, nrow(data))
  total_weight <- sum(abs(weights))
  
  for (i in seq_along(features)) {
    feature <- features[i]
    weight <- weights[i]
    
    # Normalize each feature to 0-1 scale
    if (sd(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
      normalized_feature <- (data[[feature]] - min(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE)) / 
        (max(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE) - min(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE))
    } else {
      normalized_feature <- 0.5
    }
    
    # For negative weights, invert the score (lower raw value = higher score)
    if (weight < 0) {
      normalized_feature <- 1 - normalized_feature
    }
    
    scores <- scores + (normalized_feature * abs(weight))
  }
  
  return(scores / total_weight)
```
```{r}
}

# --- Apply the same processing as other positions ---
percent_to_numeric <- function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) {
    out <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("%","", x)))
    return(ifelse(is.na(out), NA_real_, out/100))
  }
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}

# Build numeric matrix
de_input_all <- de_week2_proc %>%
  mutate(
    across(all_of(model_features_de), ~ {
      v <- percent_to_numeric(.x)
      v[is.infinite(v)] <- NA_real_
      v
    })
  )

# Impute missing values
feats_needing_impute <- model_features_de
de_medians <- vapply(
  feats_needing_impute,
  function(f) suppressWarnings(stats::median(as.numeric(de_input_all[[f]]), na.rm = TRUE)),
  numeric(1)
)
de_medians[is.na(de_medians)] <- 0

for (f in model_features_de) {
  fill_val <- ifelse(f %in% names(de_medians), de_medians[[f]], 0)
  de_input_all[[f]][is.na(de_input_all[[f]])] <- fill_val
}

# Calculate weighted composite score
calculate_weighted_score <- function(data, features, weights) {
  scores <- rep(0, nrow(data))
  total_weight <- sum(abs(weights))
  
  for (i in seq_along(features)) {
    feature <- features[i]
    weight <- weights[i]
    
    # Normalize each feature to 0-1 scale
    if (sd(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
      normalized_feature <- (data[[feature]] - min(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE)) / 
        (max(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE) - min(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE))
    } else {
      normalized_feature <- 0.5
    }
    
    # For negative weights, invert the score (lower raw value = higher score)
    if (weight < 0) {
      normalized_feature <- 1 - normalized_feature
    }
    
    scores <- scores + (normalized_feature * abs(weight))
  }
  
  return(scores / total_weight)
}

de_input_all$Composite_Score <- calculate_weighted_score(de_input_all, model_features_de, feature_weights_de)

# --- Rescale Scores (0–100 + 2 decimals) like QB scores ---
if (length(unique(de_input_all$Composite_Score)) > 1) {
  min_s <- min(de_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_s <- max(de_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  de_input_all <- de_input_all %>%
    mutate(
      Composite_Score = round(
        100 * ((Composite_Score - min_s) / (max_s - min_s)),
        2
      )
    )
} else {
  de_input_all$Composite_Score <- 50
}

# Join scores back
de_scored_all <- de_week2_proc %>%
  mutate(
    row_id = row_number(),
    Composite_Score = de_input_all$Composite_Score
  )

# --- Grade Assignment (Using same scale as QB) ---
de_scored_all <- de_scored_all %>%
  mutate(
    Player_Grade = case_when(
      Composite_Score >= 80.0 ~ "A",
      Composite_Score >= 60.0 ~ "B",
      Composite_Score >= 40.0 ~ "C",
      Composite_Score >= 20.0 ~ "D",
      TRUE ~ "F"
    )
  )

# --- Join scores + grades back ---
de_combined_scored <- de_week2_proc %>%
  mutate(row_id = row_number()) %>%
  left_join(
    de_scored_all %>% select(row_id, Composite_Score, Player_Grade),
    by = "row_id"
  )

# --- DE Grade Sheet (like QB format) ---
g5_de_grade_sheet <- de_combined_scored %>%
  select(
    Name,
    Team,
    Defensive.Snaps,
    Composite_Score,

  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

View(g5_de_full_stats)
```

```{r}
# --- Apply the same processing as other positions ---
percent_to_numeric <- function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) {
    out <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("%","", x)))
    return(ifelse(is.na(out), NA_real_, out/100))
  }
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}

# Build numeric matrix
de_input_all <- de_week3_proc %>%
  mutate(
    across(all_of(model_features_de), ~ {
      v <- percent_to_numeric(.x)
      v[is.infinite(v)] <- NA_real_
      v
    })
  )

# Impute missing values
feats_needing_impute <- model_features_de
de_medians <- vapply(
  feats_needing_impute,
  function(f) suppressWarnings(stats::median(as.numeric(de_input_all[[f]]), na.rm = TRUE)),
  numeric(1)
)
de_medians[is.na(de_medians)] <- 0

for (f in model_features_de) {
  fill_val <- ifelse(f %in% names(de_medians), de_medians[[f]], 0)
  de_input_all[[f]][is.na(de_input_all[[f]])] <- fill_val
}

# Calculate weighted composite score
calculate_weighted_score <- function(data, features, weights) {
  scores <- rep(0, nrow(data))
  total_weight <- sum(abs(weights))
  
  for (i in seq_along(features)) {
    feature <- features[i]
    weight <- weights[i]
    
    # Normalize each feature to 0-1 scale
    if (sd(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
      normalized_feature <- (data[[feature]] - min(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE)) / 
        (max(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE) - min(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE))
    } else {
      normalized_feature <- 0.5
    }
    
    # For negative weights, invert the score (lower raw value = higher score)
    if (weight < 0) {
      normalized_feature <- 1 - normalized_feature
    }
    
    scores <- scores + (normalized_feature * abs(weight))
  }
  
  return(scores / total_weight)
}

de_input_all$Composite_Score <- calculate_weighted_score(de_input_all, model_features_de, feature_weights_de)

# --- Rescale Scores (0–100 + 2 decimals) like QB scores ---
if (length(unique(de_input_all$Composite_Score)) > 1) {
  min_s <- min(de_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_s <- max(de_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  de_input_all <- de_input_all %>%
    mutate(
      Composite_Score = round(
        100 * ((Composite_Score - min_s) / (max_s - min_s)),
        2
      )
    )
} else {
  de_input_all$Composite_Score <- 50
}

# Join scores back
de_scored_all <- de_week3_proc %>%
  mutate(
    row_id = row_number(),
    Composite_Score = de_input_all$Composite_Score
  )

# --- Grade Assignment (Using same scale as QB) ---
de_scored_all <- de_scored_all %>%
  mutate(
    Player_Grade = case_when(
      Composite_Score >= 80.0 ~ "A",
      Composite_Score >= 60.0 ~ "B",
      Composite_Score >= 40.0 ~ "C",
      Composite_Score >= 20.0 ~ "D",
      TRUE ~ "F"
    )
  )

# --- Join scores + grades back ---
de_combined_scored <- de_week3_proc %>%
  mutate(row_id = row_number()) %>%
  left_join(
    de_scored_all %>% select(row_id, Composite_Score, Player_Grade),
    by = "row_id"
  )

# --- DE Grade Sheet (like QB format) ---
g5_de_grade_sheet <- de_combined_scored %>%
  select(
    Name,
    Team,
    Defensive.Snaps,
    Composite_Score,
    Player_Grade
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

View(g5_de_grade_sheet)

# --- DE Full stats view (ALL features used in the model) ---
g5_de_full_stats <- de_combined_scored %>%
  select(
    Name, 
    Team, 
    Defensive.Snaps, 
    Composite_Score, 
    Player_Grade,
    Defensive.Grades,
    Pass.Rush.Grade,
    Run.Defense.Grade,
    all_of(setdiff(model_features_de, c("Defensive.Grades", "Pass.Rush.Grade", "Run.Defense.Grade")))
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

View(g5_de_full_stats)

cat("Median Composite Score:", round(median(g5_de_grade_sheet$Composite_Score), 2), "\n")
cat("Highest Score:", max(g5_de_grade_sheet$Composite_Score), "\n")
```

```{r}
percent_to_numeric <- function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) {
    out <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("%","", x)))
    return(ifelse(is.na(out), NA_real_, out/100))
  }
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}

# Build numeric matrix
de_input_all <- de_week4_proc %>%
  mutate(
    across(all_of(model_features_de), ~ {
      v <- percent_to_numeric(.x)
      v[is.infinite(v)] <- NA_real_
      v
    })
  )

# Impute missing values

de_medians <- vapply(
  feats_needing_impute,
  function(f) suppressWarnings(stats::median(as.numeric(de_input_all[[f]]), na.rm = TRUE)),
  numeric(1)
)
```

```{r}
for (f in model_features_de) {
  fill_val <- ifelse(f %in% names(de_medians), de_medians[[f]], 0)
  de_input_all[[f]][is.na(de_input_all[[f]])] <- fill_val
}

# Calculate weighted composite score
calculate_weighted_score <- function(data, features, weights) {
  scores <- rep(0, nrow(data))
  total_weight <- sum(abs(weights))
  
  for (i in seq_along(features)) {
    feature <- features[i]
    weight <- weights[i]
    
    # Normalize each feature to 0-1 scale
    if (sd(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
      normalized_feature <- (data[[feature]] - min(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE)) / 
        (max(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE) - min(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE))
    } else {
      normalized_feature <- 0.5
    }
    
    # For negative weights, invert the score (lower raw value = higher score)
    if (weight < 0) {
      normalized_feature <- 1 - normalized_feature
    }
    
    scores <- scores + (normalized_feature * abs(weight))
  }
  
  return(scores / total_weight)
}

de_input_all$Composite_Score <- calculate_weighted_score(de_input_all, model_features_de, feature_weights_de)

# --- Rescale Scores (0–100 + 2 decimals) like QB scores ---
if (length(unique(de_input_all$Composite_Score)) > 1) {
  min_s <- min(de_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_s <- max(de_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  de_input_all <- de_input_all %>%
    mutate(
      Composite_Score = round(
        100 * ((Composite_Score - min_s) / (max_s - min_s)),
        2
      )
    )
} else {
  de_input_all$Composite_Score <- 50
}

# Join scores back
de_scored_all <- de_week4_proc %>%
  mutate(
    row_id = row_number(),
    Composite_Score = de_input_all$Composite_Score
  )

# --- Grade Assignment (Using same scale as QB) ---
de_scored_all <- de_scored_all %>%
  mutate(
    Player_Grade = case_when(
      Composite_Score >= 80.0 ~ "A",
      Composite_Score >= 60.0 ~ "B",
      Composite_Score >= 40.0 ~ "C",
      Composite_Score >= 20.0 ~ "D",
      TRUE ~ "F"
    )
  )

# --- Join scores + grades back ---
de_combined_scored <- de_week4_proc %>%
  mutate(row_id = row_number()) %>%
  left_join(
    de_scored_all %>% select(row_id, Composite_Score, Player_Grade),
    by = "row_id"
  )

# --- DE Grade Sheet (like QB format) ---
g5_de_grade_sheet <- de_combined_scored %>%
  select(
    Name,
    Team,
    Defensive.Snaps,
    Composite_Score,
    Player_Grade
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

View(g5_de_grade_sheet)

# --- DE Full stats view (ALL features used in the model) ---

  select(

    Run.Defense.Grade,
    all_of(setdiff(model_features_de, c("Defensive.Grades", "Pass.Rush.Grade", "Run.Defense.Grade")))
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

View(g5_de_full_stats)
```

```{r}
# --- Apply the same processing as other positions ---
percent_to_numeric <- function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) {
    out <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("%","", x)))
    return(ifelse(is.na(out), NA_real_, out/100))
  }
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}

# Build numeric matrix

      v
    })
  )

)
```

```{r}
  fill_val <- ifelse(f %in% names(de_medians), de_medians[[f]], 0)
  de_input_all[[f]][is.na(de_input_all[[f]])] <- fill_val
}

# Calculate weighted composite score
calculate_weighted_score <- function(data, features, weights) {
  scores <- rep(0, nrow(data))
  total_weight <- sum(abs(weights))
  
  for (i in seq_along(features)) {
    feature <- features[i]
    weight <- weights[i]
    
    # Normalize each feature to 0-1 scale
    if (sd(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
      normalized_feature <- (data[[feature]] - min(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE)) / 
        (max(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE) - min(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE))
    } else {
      normalized_feature <- 0.5
    }
    
    # For negative weights, invert the score (lower raw value = higher score)
    if (weight < 0) {
      normalized_feature <- 1 - normalized_feature
    }
    
    scores <- scores + (normalized_feature * abs(weight))
  }
  
  return(scores / total_weight)
}

de_input_all$Composite_Score <- calculate_weighted_score(de_input_all, model_features_de, feature_weights_de)

# --- Rescale Scores (0–100 + 2 decimals) like QB scores ---
if (length(unique(de_input_all$Composite_Score)) > 1) {
  min_s <- min(de_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_s <- max(de_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  de_input_all <- de_input_all %>%
    mutate(
      Composite_Score = round(
        100 * ((Composite_Score - min_s) / (max_s - min_s)),
        2
      )
    )
} else {
  de_input_all$Composite_Score <- 50
}

# Join scores back
de_scored_all <- de_week5_proc %>%
  mutate(
    row_id = row_number(),
    Composite_Score = de_input_all$Composite_Score
  )

# --- Grade Assignment (Using same scale as QB) ---
de_scored_all <- de_scored_all %>%
  mutate(
    Player_Grade = case_when(
      Composite_Score >= 80.0 ~ "A",
      Composite_Score >= 60.0 ~ "B",
      Composite_Score >= 40.0 ~ "C",
      Composite_Score >= 20.0 ~ "D",
      TRUE ~ "F"
    )
  )

# --- Join scores + grades back ---
de_combined_scored <- de_week5_proc %>%
  mutate(row_id = row_number()) %>%
  left_join(
    de_scored_all %>% select(row_id, Composite_Score, Player_Grade),
    by = "row_id"
  )

# --- DE Grade Sheet (like QB format) ---
g5_de_grade_sheet <- de_combined_scored %>%
  select(
    Name,
    Team,
    Defensive.Snaps,
    Composite_Score,
    Player_Grade
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

View(g5_de_grade_sheet)

# --- DE Full stats view (ALL features used in the model) ---
g5_de_full_stats <- de_combined_scored %>%
  select(
    Name, 
    Team, 
    Defensive.Snaps, 
    Composite_Score, 
    Player_Grade,
    Defensive.Grades,
    Pass.Rush.Grade,
    Run.Defense.Grade,
    all_of(setdiff(model_features_de, c("Defensive.Grades", "Pass.Rush.Grade", "Run.Defense.Grade")))
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

View(g5_de_full_stats)

cat("\n=== SUMMARY STATISTICS ===\n")

cat("Median Composite Score:", round(median(g5_de_grade_sheet$Composite_Score), 2), "\n")
```

```{r}
percent_to_numeric <- function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) {
    out <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("%","", x)))
    return(ifelse(is.na(out), NA_real_, out/100))
  }
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}

  de_input_all[[f]][is.na(de_input_all[[f]])] <- fill_val
}

# Calculate weighted composite score
calculate_weighted_score <- function(data, features, weights) {
  scores <- rep(0, nrow(data))
  total_weight <- sum(abs(weights))
  
  for (i in seq_along(features)) {
    feature <- features[i]
    weight <- weights[i]
    
    # Normalize each feature to 0-1 scale
    if (sd(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
      normalized_feature <- (data[[feature]] - min(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE)) / 
        (max(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE) - min(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE))
    } else {
      normalized_feature <- 0.5
    }
    
    # For negative weights, invert the score (lower raw value = higher score)
    if (weight < 0) {
      normalized_feature <- 1 - normalized_feature
    }
    
    scores <- scores + (normalized_feature * abs(weight))
  }
  
  return(scores / total_weight)
}

de_input_all$Composite_Score <- calculate_weighted_score(de_input_all, model_features_de, feature_weights_de)

# --- Rescale Scores (0–100 + 2 decimals) like QB scores ---
if (length(unique(de_input_all$Composite_Score)) > 1) {
  min_s <- min(de_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_s <- max(de_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  de_input_all <- de_input_all %>%
    mutate(
      Composite_Score = round(
        100 * ((Composite_Score - min_s) / (max_s - min_s)),
        2
      )
    )
} else {
  de_input_all$Composite_Score <- 50
}

    row_id = row_number(),
    Composite_Score = de_input_all$Composite_Score
  )
```

```{r}
  mutate(
    Player_Grade = case_when(
      Composite_Score >= 80.0 ~ "A",
      Composite_Score >= 60.0 ~ "B",
      Composite_Score >= 40.0 ~ "C",
      Composite_Score >= 20.0 ~ "D",
      TRUE ~ "F"
    )
  )

# --- Join scores + grades back ---
de_combined_scored <- de_week6_proc %>%
  mutate(row_id = row_number()) %>%
  left_join(
    de_scored_all %>% select(row_id, Composite_Score, Player_Grade),
    by = "row_id"
  )

# --- DE Grade Sheet (like QB format) ---
g5_de_grade_sheet <- de_combined_scored %>%
  select(
    Name,
    Team,
    Defensive.Snaps,
    Composite_Score,
    Player_Grade
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

View(g5_de_grade_sheet)

# --- DE Full stats view (ALL features used in the model) ---

  select(

    Player_Grade,

    Pass.Rush.Grade,
    Run.Defense.Grade,
    all_of(setdiff(model_features_de, c("Defensive.Grades", "Pass.Rush.Grade", "Run.Defense.Grade")))
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

View(g5_de_full_stats)
```

```{r}
# --- Apply the same processing as other positions ---
percent_to_numeric <- function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) {
    out <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("%","", x)))
    return(ifelse(is.na(out), NA_real_, out/100))
  }
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}

# Build numeric matrix

  mutate(

      v
    })
  )

)
```

```{r}
  fill_val <- ifelse(f %in% names(de_medians), de_medians[[f]], 0)
  de_input_all[[f]][is.na(de_input_all[[f]])] <- fill_val
}

# Calculate weighted composite score
calculate_weighted_score <- function(data, features, weights) {
  scores <- rep(0, nrow(data))
  total_weight <- sum(abs(weights))
  
  for (i in seq_along(features)) {
    feature <- features[i]
    weight <- weights[i]
    
    # Normalize each feature to 0-1 scale
    if (sd(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
      normalized_feature <- (data[[feature]] - min(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE)) / 
        (max(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE) - min(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE))
    } else {
      normalized_feature <- 0.5
    }
    
    # For negative weights, invert the score (lower raw value = higher score)
    if (weight < 0) {
      normalized_feature <- 1 - normalized_feature
    }
    
    scores <- scores + (normalized_feature * abs(weight))
  }
  
  return(scores / total_weight)
}

de_input_all$Composite_Score <- calculate_weighted_score(de_input_all, model_features_de, feature_weights_de)

# --- Rescale Scores (0–100 + 2 decimals) like QB scores ---
if (length(unique(de_input_all$Composite_Score)) > 1) {
  min_s <- min(de_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_s <- max(de_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  de_input_all <- de_input_all %>%
    mutate(
      Composite_Score = round(
        100 * ((Composite_Score - min_s) / (max_s - min_s)),
        2
      )
    )
} else {
  de_input_all$Composite_Score <- 50
}

# Join scores back
de_scored_all <- de_week7_proc %>%
  mutate(
    row_id = row_number(),
    Composite_Score = de_input_all$Composite_Score
  )

# --- Grade Assignment (Using same scale as QB) ---
de_scored_all <- de_scored_all %>%
  mutate(
    Player_Grade = case_when(
      Composite_Score >= 80.0 ~ "A",
      Composite_Score >= 60.0 ~ "B",
      Composite_Score >= 40.0 ~ "C",
      Composite_Score >= 20.0 ~ "D",
      TRUE ~ "F"
    )
  )

# --- Join scores + grades back ---
de_combined_scored <- de_week7_proc %>%
  mutate(row_id = row_number()) %>%
  left_join(
    de_scored_all %>% select(row_id, Composite_Score, Player_Grade),
    by = "row_id"
  )

# --- DE Grade Sheet (like QB format) ---
g5_de_grade_sheet <- de_combined_scored %>%
  select(
    Name,
    Team,
    Defensive.Snaps,
    Composite_Score,
    Player_Grade
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

View(g5_de_grade_sheet)

# --- DE Full stats view (ALL features used in the model) ---

  select(
    Name,

    Defensive.Snaps, 
    Composite_Score, 
    Player_Grade,
    Defensive.Grades,
    Pass.Rush.Grade,
    Run.Defense.Grade,
    all_of(setdiff(model_features_de, c("Defensive.Grades", "Pass.Rush.Grade", "Run.Defense.Grade")))
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

View(g5_de_full_stats)
```

```{r}
  "Total.Pressures.Generated" = 22,

)
```

```{r}
  }
}

# --- Apply the same processing as other positions ---
percent_to_numeric <- function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) {
    out <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("%","", x)))
    return(ifelse(is.na(out), NA_real_, out/100))
  }
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}

# Build numeric matrix
de_input_all <- de_week8_proc %>%
  mutate(
    across(all_of(model_features_de), ~ {
      v <- percent_to_numeric(.x)
      v[is.infinite(v)] <- NA_real_
      v
    })
  )

# Impute missing values
feats_needing_impute <- model_features_de
de_medians <- vapply(
  feats_needing_impute,
  function(f) suppressWarnings(stats::median(as.numeric(de_input_all[[f]]), na.rm = TRUE)),
  numeric(1)
)
de_medians[is.na(de_medians)] <- 0

for (f in model_features_de) {
  fill_val <- ifelse(f %in% names(de_medians), de_medians[[f]], 0)
  de_input_all[[f]][is.na(de_input_all[[f]])] <- fill_val
}

# Calculate weighted composite score
calculate_weighted_score <- function(data, features, weights) {
  scores <- rep(0, nrow(data))
  total_weight <- sum(abs(weights))
  
  for (i in seq_along(features)) {
    feature <- features[i]
    weight <- weights[i]
    
    # Normalize each feature to 0-1 scale
    if (sd(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
      normalized_feature <- (data[[feature]] - min(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE)) / 
        (max(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE) - min(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE))
    } else {
      normalized_feature <- 0.5
    }
    
    # For negative weights, invert the score (lower raw value = higher score)
    if (weight < 0) {
      normalized_feature <- 1 - normalized_feature
    }
    
    scores <- scores + (normalized_feature * abs(weight))
  }
  
  return(scores / total_weight)
}

de_input_all$Composite_Score <- calculate_weighted_score(de_input_all, model_features_de, feature_weights_de)

# --- Rescale Scores (0–100 + 2 decimals) like QB scores ---
if (length(unique(de_input_all$Composite_Score)) > 1) {
  min_s <- min(de_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_s <- max(de_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  de_input_all <- de_input_all %>%
    mutate(
      Composite_Score = round(
        100 * ((Composite_Score - min_s) / (max_s - min_s)),
        2
      )
    )
} else {
  de_input_all$Composite_Score <- 50
}

# Join scores back
de_scored_all <- de_week8_proc %>%
  mutate(
    row_id = row_number(),
    Composite_Score = de_input_all$Composite_Score
  )

# --- Grade Assignment (Using same scale as QB) ---
de_scored_all <- de_scored_all %>%
  mutate(
    Player_Grade = case_when(
      Composite_Score >= 80.0 ~ "A",
      Composite_Score >= 60.0 ~ "B",
      Composite_Score >= 40.0 ~ "C",
      Composite_Score >= 20.0 ~ "D",
      TRUE ~ "F"
    )
  )

# --- Join scores + grades back ---
de_combined_scored <- de_week8_proc %>%
  mutate(row_id = row_number()) %>%
  left_join(
    de_scored_all %>% select(row_id, Composite_Score, Player_Grade),
    by = "row_id"
  )

# --- DE Grade Sheet (like QB format) ---
g5_de_grade_sheet <- de_combined_scored %>%
  select(
    Name,
    Team,
    Defensive.Snaps,
    Composite_Score,
    Player_Grade
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

View(g5_de_grade_sheet)

# --- DE Full stats view (ALL features used in the model) ---
g5_de_full_stats <- de_combined_scored %>%
  select(

    Composite_Score, 
    Player_Grade,

    Pass.Rush.Grade,
    Run.Defense.Grade,
    all_of(setdiff(model_features_de, c("Defensive.Grades", "Pass.Rush.Grade", "Run.Defense.Grade")))
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

View(g5_de_full_stats)
```

```{r}
    across(all_of(model_features_de), ~ {
      v <- percent_to_numeric(.x)
      v[is.infinite(v)] <- NA_real_
      v
    })
  )

# Impute missing values
feats_needing_impute <- model_features_de
de_medians <- vapply(
  feats_needing_impute,
  function(f) suppressWarnings(stats::median(as.numeric(de_input_all[[f]]), na.rm = TRUE)),
  numeric(1)
)
de_medians[is.na(de_medians)] <- 0

for (f in model_features_de) {
  fill_val <- ifelse(f %in% names(de_medians), de_medians[[f]], 0)
  de_input_all[[f]][is.na(de_input_all[[f]])] <- fill_val
}

# Calculate weighted composite score
calculate_weighted_score <- function(data, features, weights) {
  scores <- rep(0, nrow(data))
  total_weight <- sum(abs(weights))
  
  for (i in seq_along(features)) {
    feature <- features[i]
    weight <- weights[i]
    
    # Normalize each feature to 0-1 scale
    if (sd(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
      normalized_feature <- (data[[feature]] - min(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE)) / 
        (max(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE) - min(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE))
    } else {
      normalized_feature <- 0.5
    }
    
    # For negative weights, invert the score (lower raw value = higher score)
    if (weight < 0) {
      normalized_feature <- 1 - normalized_feature
    }
    
    scores <- scores + (normalized_feature * abs(weight))
  }
  
  return(scores / total_weight)
}

de_input_all$Composite_Score <- calculate_weighted_score(de_input_all, model_features_de, feature_weights_de)

# --- Rescale Scores (0–100 + 2 decimals) like QB scores ---
if (length(unique(de_input_all$Composite_Score)) > 1) {
  min_s <- min(de_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_s <- max(de_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  de_input_all <- de_input_all %>%
    mutate(
      Composite_Score = round(
        100 * ((Composite_Score - min_s) / (max_s - min_s)),
        2
      )
    )
} else {
  de_input_all$Composite_Score <- 50
}

# Join scores back
de_scored_all <- de_week9_proc %>%
  mutate(
    row_id = row_number(),
    Composite_Score = de_input_all$Composite_Score
  )

# --- Grade Assignment (Using same scale as QB) ---
de_scored_all <- de_scored_all %>%
  mutate(
    Player_Grade = case_when(
      Composite_Score >= 80.0 ~ "A",
      Composite_Score >= 60.0 ~ "B",
      Composite_Score >= 40.0 ~ "C",
      Composite_Score >= 20.0 ~ "D",
      TRUE ~ "F"
    )
  )

# --- Join scores + grades back ---
de_combined_scored <- de_week9_proc %>%
  mutate(row_id = row_number()) %>%
  left_join(
    de_scored_all %>% select(row_id, Composite_Score, Player_Grade),
    by = "row_id"
  )

# --- DE Grade Sheet (like QB format) ---
```
```{r}
g5_de_grade_sheet <- de_combined_scored %>%
  select(
    Name,
    Team,
    Defensive.Snaps,
    Composite_Score,
    Player_Grade
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

View(g5_de_grade_sheet)

# --- DE Full stats view (ALL features used in the model) ---

  select(

    Composite_Score, 
    Player_Grade,

    Run.Defense.Grade,
    all_of(setdiff(model_features_de, c("Defensive.Grades", "Pass.Rush.Grade", "Run.Defense.Grade")))
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

View(g5_de_full_stats)
```

```{r}
      normalized_feature <- 0.5
    }
    
    # For negative weights, invert the score (lower raw value = higher score)
    if (weight < 0) {
      normalized_feature <- 1 - normalized_feature
    }
    
    scores <- scores + (normalized_feature * abs(weight))
  }
  
  return(scores / total_weight)
}

de_input_all$Composite_Score <- calculate_weighted_score(de_input_all, model_features_de, feature_weights_de)

# --- Rescale Scores (0–100 + 2 decimals) like QB scores ---

  max_s <- max(de_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)

}

    )

# --- Join scores + grades back ---

  )
```

```{r}
calculate_weighted_score <- function(data, features, weights) {

    if (weight < 0) {
      normalized_feature <- 1 - normalized_feature
    }
    
    scores <- scores + (normalized_feature * abs(weight))
  }
  
  return(scores / total_weight)
}
```

```{r}
percent_to_numeric <- function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) {
    out <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("%","", x)))
    return(ifelse(is.na(out), NA_real_, out/100))
  }
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))

# Build numeric matrix

  mutate(

      v
    })
  )

  fill_val <- ifelse(f %in% names(de_medians), de_medians[[f]], 0)
  de_input_all[[f]][is.na(de_input_all[[f]])] <- fill_val
}

# Calculate weighted composite score
calculate_weighted_score <- function(data, features, weights) {
  scores <- rep(0, nrow(data))
  total_weight <- sum(abs(weights))
  
  for (i in seq_along(features)) {
    feature <- features[i]
    weight <- weights[i]
    
    # Normalize each feature to 0-1 scale
    if (sd(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
      normalized_feature <- (data[[feature]] - min(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE)) / 
        (max(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE) - min(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE))
    } else {
      normalized_feature <- 0.5
    }
    
    # For negative weights, invert the score (lower raw value = higher score)
    if (weight < 0) {
      normalized_feature <- 1 - normalized_feature
    }
    
    scores <- scores + (normalized_feature * abs(weight))
  }
  
  return(scores / total_weight)
}

de_input_all$Composite_Score <- calculate_weighted_score(de_input_all, model_features_de, feature_weights_de)

# --- Rescale Scores (0–100 + 2 decimals) like QB scores ---
if (length(unique(de_input_all$Composite_Score)) > 1) {
  min_s <- min(de_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_s <- max(de_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  de_input_all <- de_input_all %>%
    mutate(
      Composite_Score = round(
        100 * ((Composite_Score - min_s) / (max_s - min_s)),
        2
      )
    )
} else {
  de_input_all$Composite_Score <- 50
}

# Join scores back
de_scored_all <- de_week11_proc %>%
  mutate(
    row_id = row_number(),
    Composite_Score = de_input_all$Composite_Score
  )

# --- Grade Assignment (Using same scale as QB) ---
de_scored_all <- de_scored_all %>%
  mutate(
    Player_Grade = case_when(
      Composite_Score >= 80.0 ~ "A",
      Composite_Score >= 60.0 ~ "B",
      Composite_Score >= 40.0 ~ "C",
      Composite_Score >= 20.0 ~ "D",
      TRUE ~ "F"
    )
  )

# --- Join scores + grades back ---
de_combined_scored <- de_week11_proc %>%
  mutate(row_id = row_number()) %>%
  left_join(
    de_scored_all %>% select(row_id, Composite_Score, Player_Grade),
    by = "row_id"
  )

# --- DE Grade Sheet (like QB format) ---
p4_de_grade_sheet <- de_combined_scored %>%
  select(
    Name,
    Team,
    Defensive.Snaps,
    Composite_Score,
```

```{r}
percent_to_numeric <- function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) {
    out <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("%","", x)))
    return(ifelse(is.na(out), NA_real_, out/100))

  de_input_all[[f]][is.na(de_input_all[[f]])] <- fill_val
}

# Calculate weighted composite score
calculate_weighted_score <- function(data, features, weights) {
  scores <- rep(0, nrow(data))
  total_weight <- sum(abs(weights))
  
  for (i in seq_along(features)) {
    feature <- features[i]
    weight <- weights[i]
    
    # Normalize each feature to 0-1 scale
    if (sd(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
      normalized_feature <- (data[[feature]] - min(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE)) / 
        (max(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE) - min(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE))
    } else {
      normalized_feature <- 0.5
    }
    
    # For negative weights, invert the score (lower raw value = higher score)
    if (weight < 0) {
      normalized_feature <- 1 - normalized_feature
    }
    
    scores <- scores + (normalized_feature * abs(weight))
  }
  
  return(scores / total_weight)
}

de_input_all$Composite_Score <- calculate_weighted_score(de_input_all, model_features_de, feature_weights_de)

# --- Rescale Scores (0–100 + 2 decimals) like QB scores ---
if (length(unique(de_input_all$Composite_Score)) > 1) {
  min_s <- min(de_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_s <- max(de_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  de_input_all <- de_input_all %>%
    mutate(
      Composite_Score = round(
        100 * ((Composite_Score - min_s) / (max_s - min_s)),
        2
      )
    )
} else {
  de_input_all$Composite_Score <- 50
}

# Join scores back

  mutate(
    row_id = row_number(),
    Composite_Score = de_input_all$Composite_Score
  )

# --- Grade Assignment (Using same scale as QB) ---
de_scored_all <- de_scored_all %>%
  mutate(
    Player_Grade = case_when(
      Composite_Score >= 80.0 ~ "A",
      Composite_Score >= 60.0 ~ "B",
      Composite_Score >= 40.0 ~ "C",
      Composite_Score >= 20.0 ~ "D",
      TRUE ~ "F"
    )
  )

# --- Join scores + grades back ---
```
```{r}
de_combined_scored <- de_week13_proc %>%
  mutate(row_id = row_number()) %>%
  left_join(
    de_scored_all %>% select(row_id, Composite_Score, Player_Grade),
    by = "row_id"
  )

# --- DE Grade Sheet (like QB format) ---
p4_de_grade_sheet <- de_combined_scored %>%
  select(
    Name,
    Team,
    Defensive.Snaps,
    Composite_Score,
    Player_Grade
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

View(p4_de_grade_sheet)

    all_of(setdiff(model_features_de, c("Defensive.Grades", "Pass.Rush.Grade", "Run.Defense.Grade")))

View(p4_de_full_stats)
```

```{r}
  if (is.character(x)) {

# Calculate weighted composite score
calculate_weighted_score <- function(data, features, weights) {
  scores <- rep(0, nrow(data))
  total_weight <- sum(abs(weights))
  
  for (i in seq_along(features)) {
    feature <- features[i]
    weight <- weights[i]
    
    # Normalize each feature to 0-1 scale
    if (sd(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
      normalized_feature <- (data[[feature]] - min(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE)) / 
        (max(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE) - min(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE))
    } else {
      normalized_feature <- 0.5
    }
    
    # For negative weights, invert the score (lower raw value = higher score)
    if (weight < 0) {
      normalized_feature <- 1 - normalized_feature
    }
    
    scores <- scores + (normalized_feature * abs(weight))
  }
  
  return(scores / total_weight)
}

de_input_all$Composite_Score <- calculate_weighted_score(de_input_all, model_features_de, feature_weights_de)

# --- Rescale Scores (0–100 + 2 decimals) like QB scores ---
if (length(unique(de_input_all$Composite_Score)) > 1) {
  min_s <- min(de_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_s <- max(de_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  de_input_all <- de_input_all %>%
    mutate(
      Composite_Score = round(
        100 * ((Composite_Score - min_s) / (max_s - min_s)),
        2
      )
    )
} else {
  de_input_all$Composite_Score <- 50
}

    row_id = row_number(),
    Composite_Score = de_input_all$Composite_Score
  )

  mutate(
    Player_Grade = case_when(
      Composite_Score >= 80.0 ~ "A",
      Composite_Score >= 60.0 ~ "B",
      Composite_Score >= 40.0 ~ "C",
      Composite_Score >= 20.0 ~ "D",
      TRUE ~ "F"
    )
  )

# --- Join scores + grades back ---
```
```{r}
de_combined_scored <- de_week14_proc %>%
  mutate(row_id = row_number()) %>%
  left_join(
    de_scored_all %>% select(row_id, Composite_Score, Player_Grade),
    by = "row_id"
  )

  select(
```
